rv.q: You will walk away wondering if what you think you know about how things work in life are completely false.
Most people are completely overwhelmed and amazed when they leave.
Do not miss Spellbound. It plays at the SoHo Playhouse through September 6th, so you have two more performances to catch her.

cn.t: Mentalist Suhani Shah captivates audiences with her mind-reading feats and charming stage presence. Critics praise her effortless connection with the crowd, calling the show mind-blowing and delightfully entertaining.
